summary_bullets: Add has_bump and defer_push parity inputs to rebase_and_rebump
Thread base_remote/base_ref through apply_bump guard fetch and show
Cover defer_push, has_bump=false, and upstream-base paths in unit tests
commit_message:
Port rebase rebump defer_push/HAS_BUMP and apply_bump base parity (#3317)

Gate classify/apply/changelog on has_bump and derive pushed from defer_push in rebase_and_rebump. Parameterize apply_bump race-retry guards on base_remote/base_ref and pass the rebase base through from the caller.
